key_idea: Count all the red stickers, then take away the red square ones.
steps: Half of 18 is 9, so 9 stickers are red.
There are 18 - 10 = 8 square stickers, and only 1 of them is not blue. So 1 square sticker is red.
The other red stickers are round: 9 - 1 = 8.

choice_feedback.A: Then there would be only 5 + 1 = 6 red stickers, but there are 9.
choice_feedback.B: Then there would be only 6 + 1 = 7 red stickers, but there are 9.
choice_feedback.C: Then there would be only 7 + 1 = 8 red stickers, but there are 9.
choice_feedback.E: 9 is all the red stickers, but 1 of them is square.
